summary: Appointment requests kept climbing on the strength of the new landing pages. The Wedding Dress Timeline and venue pages are pulling organic traffic while paid search holds a steady cost per booked appointment.
coverSub: How paid search and the new Squarespace landing pages worked together to keep bridal appointment requests growing this month.
headline: The new landing pages are compounding: organic sessions grew again and paid search held a steady cost per appointment. Conversion tracking on the new account is verified, so every booked appointment is now measured.
snapshotLead: Paid search stayed efficient while the Timeline and venue pages kept adding organic appointment paths on top of it.
takeaway: Paid and organic are now feeding the same funnel. The venue pages give brides a reason to land, and search campaigns catch the ones who are ready to book. July's job is more of both.
